verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is an international law firm, so an official developer CLI is not a fair axis for comparing products of this kind. Its documented digital offerings are web questionnaires (SCC Generator, Term Sheet Generator built on Contract Express), a HighQ deal room and AI review via Legora and Luminance. None of these is, or suggests, a command-line tool, and probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
